properties.description: Ages the open AR invoices and publishes the result to the gold layer and the warehouse.

source: Reads the curated invoice fact and the customer dimension, writes the aging table.

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

fact = (spark.read
        .format("delta")
        .load("abfss://curated@contosolake.dfs.core.windows.net/finance/fact_ar_invoice"))
customers = spark.read.table("silver.dim_customer")
fact.createOrReplaceTempView("fact_open")
customers.createOrReplaceTempView("cust")

%%sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gold.ar_aging AS
SELECT c.customer_name,
       CASE WHEN datediff(current_date(), f.invoice_date) <= 30 THEN '0-30'
            WHEN datediff(current_date(), f.invoice_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60'
            ELSE '60+' END AS aging_bucket,
       SUM(f.open_amount_usd) AS open_amount_usd
FROM fact_open f
JOIN cust c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
LEFT JOIN silver.credit_holds h ON h.customer_key = f.customer_key
GROUP BY 1, 2

aging = spark.table("gold.ar_aging")
(aging.write
      .mode("overwrite")
      .parquet("abfss://curated@contosolake.dfs.core.windows.net/finance/ar_aging"))

# the run date decides the snapshot folder — a path built at run time
snapshot = f"abfss://curated@contosolake.dfs.core.windows.net/finance/ar_aging_snapshots/{run_date}"
aging.write.mode("overwrite").save(snapshot)
